reports.title: Penumbra, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Financial Outlook and Webcast and Conference Call Information
section: Given the pending acquisition of Penumbra, Inc. by Boston Scientific Corporation (NYSE: BSX), the Company will not be providing financial guidance for the full year 2026 or hosting a conference call to discuss financial results for the three months ended September 30, 2026.
